annotations.title: Get the ticket checkout link for an event

description: Returns the link to WaitApp's ticket checkout page for an event, with the chosen ticket type and quantity filled in. The guest opens it, sees the exact price, and buys the tickets themselves; this tool charges nothing and sends no payment prompt. check_event_availability shows what is left and the ticket types (tierId).
name: get_ticket_checkout_link
title: Get the ticket checkout link for an event
